description: This file contains shell functions for upgrading and flashing Zyxel network devices. It includes functions to get the root filesystem device, flash new firmware, and perform an upgrade process tailored for specific Zyxel hardware models.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Extracts the root filesystem device from the kernel command line.

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Flashes kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive, creates an overlay filesystem, and updates dual-flag as appropriate.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process specific to Zyxel devices, determining appropriate kernel and root filesystem partitions based on device model and current boot state.
